title: Scene editor: pictures on the beat
caption: Stage 2 of the scene editor. A picture beat now makes new versions of its picture, repaints a painted part, compares two versions side by side and picks one, and a private scene can get a picture beat of its own. Public saves run the story checks and the voice manifest. These shots use the test scene's stand-in picture; the editor shows the real ones.

sections.title: Versions of a shot
sections.caption: Picture tab: New version and Repaint a part, then every version of the shot. Clicking one opens Compare.

images.caption: The Picture tab with a new version, 1366 x 768
Compare: the one the beat uses on the left, Use this one on the right
Repaint a part: paint over it, say what goes there and how much

sections.title: A picture beat of its own
sections.caption: The + between beats adds a Picture in a private scene. It waits for a picture to be composed or picked; Save needs one.

images.caption: A new picture beat, before its picture

sections.title: Checks on a public save
sections.caption: A day-2 office scene saved in a test copy. A save the story check refuses is not written, and the finding sits on the beat. A changed line says it has no voice clip yet.

images.caption: The delivery cleared on a day-2 line: refused, in plain words on the beat
Saved with the delivery back: the line has no voice clip yet
